about.title: About Me
about.description: Spanish (Native) · English (A2 – Technical) — Clean code, scalable architecture, and attention to detail.
about.paragraph1: I am a web developer with academic training and continuous self-learning, specializing in the Frontend ecosystem (Angular, React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Webflow) and desktop application development with Electron.js.
about.paragraph2: I have expanded my scope into Full Stack development and software architecture, building modular backends with Node.js, NestJS, and Express, SQL/PostgreSQL databases with Prisma, Supabase, and Firebase, applying Hexagonal Architecture, Monorepos, Kanban/Trello workflows, and CI/CD pipelines (SonarQube, OWASP). I augment my engineering workflow with AI tools (Claude, GPT, Antigravity CLI, Skills, Harness), Docker environments, and IT support & network diagnostics.

list.title: Fidelity Wallet
list.description: B2B2C digital loyalty SaaS platform built in a monorepo. Issues stamp and points cards for Google and Apple Wallet via QR without app installs, with an HMAC-validated web scanner, transactional FIFO redemptions, and a multi-branch panel. Cloud deployment with frontend on Vercel and backend on Render.
